description: This file defines the ConnectionManagerLifecycleAdapter class, which implements lifecycle participation and observation for managing connection lifecycle events within the Orleans runtime messaging system.

classes.name: ConnectionManagerLifecycleAdapter
classes.description: A class that adapts lifecycle events to manage connection lifecycle, implementing ILifecycleParticipant and ILifecycleObserver.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles the start event of the lifecycle, currently a no-op returning a completed task.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the stop event of the lifecycle, invoking the connection manager's Close method asynchronously.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the adapter to lifecycle events, specifically for the RuntimeInitialize stage.
